rejection_summary: The Breakthrough (2025): revelation-cadence failure; long stretches of investigation pass without meaningful new answers and the decisive breakthrough is concentrated at the end.
The Gardener (2025): romance/drama dominant and weak final payoff; research did not support sufficient progressive revelation.
The Waterfront (2025): crime-family drama rather than a sufficiently mystery/revelation-driven thriller fit.
The Åre Murders (2025): two compact cases with investigation, but available evidence was insufficient to establish a complete live DNA vector confidently enough for deterministic acceptance.
